newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends strongly up on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends strongly up on technical buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices surged in afternoon trade on technical buying and short covering, despite lower soyoil values overnight. Interest emerged after Aug futures broke the pyschological 1,200 level. The next resistance is 1,220. The rise also reflected technical adjustment after recent gains.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Some buying was seen from refiners and local dealers but the buying fizzled out in late trade.
"The August futures closed above the 1,200 level. This means that there is a possibility that prices could move up and we would see a resistance of 1,220 ringgit in the near-term," a trader said.
The August futures contract ended 15 ringgit higher at 1,215 ringgit ($484.06) a tonne. Other contracts also posted double-digit gains.
Some traders were optimistic that the August futures might extend its rally if soyoil futures rebound tonight.
Soyoil futures in Chicago on Tuesday closed lower but this did not dampen palm prices today.
"Refiners and local dealers were seen buying in the products market but the buying fizzled off thereafter," a physical trader said,
He said physical interest was confined to nearby CPOS and selected products.
Trading activity was much reduced and turnover was 1,650 lots.
Physical June (south) saw offers at 1,275 against bids at 1,272.50 with earlier trades done at 1,272.50.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered $537.50, and July/Aug/Sept at $530. June was traded at $532.50 and $533.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $575, July at $567.50 and Aug/Sept at $560. July was traded at $562.50 and $565, while July/Aug/Sept was done at $560.
June RBD palm stearin was offered at $405 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $272.
